site.name: Saints John Mine & Mill
overview: A historic mine-and-mill complex near Montezuma with extensive collapsed timber, masonry, waste-rock, and industrial remains. The surviving landscape helps distinguish the mine workings from the mill and other industrial components.

timeline.text: Saints John developed as an important silver-lead-zinc mining complex in the Montezuma district.
Surviving ruins and field documentation help interpret the relationship between the mine workings, mill, and industrial remains.

features.name: Mill / Industrial Ruins
features.note: The surviving collapsed timber and masonry are consistent with the documented Saints John industrial complex; individual building functions are still being resolved.

features.name: Mine Workings
features.note: The broader Saints John property includes mine workings on the surrounding mountain in addition to the mill and industrial remains.
